text: APR - the Rwandan champions, owned and funded by Rwanda's Ministry of Defence (Wikipedia APR BBC; OFAC lists the RDF under the Ministry of Defence) - withdrew from the 2026 BAL on 12 March 2026 because the US had sanctioned the Rwandan military and NBA Africa is an American entity; FERWABA named RSSB Tigers as the replacement on 20 March 2026.
short: APR withdrew from BAL 2026 after US sanctions on the RDF

source.name: Wikipedia - 2026 BAL season (withdrawal and replacement dates; lead only, needs a primary source)
